item.description: A major Rutland area drug dealer was sentenced to over seven years in prison. Guadalupe Vargas ran a drug operation using apartments in Rutland City. Authorities seized drugs, guns, and cash linked to gang activity and a California murder.
A Port Henry man was arrested after an assault in Moriah. The New York State Police are investigating the case. Further details have not been disclosed.
East Street in Clarendon is closed from Bump Road to Haven Hill due to a culvert replacement. It's expected that the street will open again tomorrow afternoon.

Wreaths Across America needs more than four thousand three hundred wreaths to honor Vermont's fallen veterans. Thousands of graves remain without wreaths as Veterans Day approaches. Vermonters are encouraged to sponsor wreaths to pay tribute.
